name: Bongani Adams

summary: Junior Mine Planning Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience in mine design, resource estimation, and digital modeling. Proven track record in using industry-standard tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness in mining operations. Strong foundation in geostatistics and sustainable mining practices.
